description: This Java source file defines the JsonCommand class, which provides an immutable representation of a JSON-based command with various methods for extracting and comparing parameter values, used within the Apache Fineract project.

classes.name: JsonCommand
classes.description: Immutable class representing a JSON command with methods for extracting and comparing parameters.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Creates a JsonCommand instance from JSON string and parsed JSON element.

methods.name: fromExistingCommand
methods.description: Creates a new JsonCommand based on an existing command, optionally with a new parsed JSON.

methods.name: fromJsonElement
methods.description: Creates a JsonCommand from a resource ID and a parsed JSON element.

methods.name: json
methods.description: Returns the original JSON string.

methods.name: parsedJson
methods.description: Returns the parsed JSON element.

methods.name: jsonElement
methods.description: Retrieves a specific JSON element by parameter name.

methods.name: jsonFragment
methods.description: Returns a JSON fragment as string for a given parameter.

methods.name: parameterExists
methods.description: Checks if a parameter exists in the JSON.

methods.name: hasParameter
methods.description: Alias for parameterExists.

methods.name: hasParameterValue
methods.description: Checks if a parameter has a value.

methods.name: isChangeInLongParameterNamed
methods.description: Checks if a Long parameter value has changed from existing.

methods.name: longValueOfParameterNamed
methods.description: Extracts a Long value for a parameter.

methods.name: isChangeInDateParameterNamed
methods.description: Checks if a LocalDate parameter value has changed.

methods.name: localDateValueOfParameterNamed
methods.description: Extracts a LocalDate value for a parameter.

methods.name: isChangeInTimeParameterNamed
methods.description: Checks if a LocalTime parameter value has changed.

methods.name: localTimeValueOfParameterNamed
methods.description: Extracts a LocalTime value for a parameter.

methods.name: isChangeInLocalTimeParameterNamed
methods.description: Checks if a LocalTime parameter value has changed.

methods.name: isChangeInLocalDateTimeParameterNamed
methods.description: Checks if a LocalDateTime parameter value has changed.

methods.name: isChangeInLocalDateParameterNamed
methods.description: Checks if a LocalDate parameter value has changed.

methods.name: localTimeValueOfParameterNamed
methods.description: Extracts a LocalTime for a parameter.

methods.name: extractMonthDayNamed
methods.description: Extracts a MonthDay for a parameter.

methods.name: dateValueOfParameterNamed
methods.description: Extracts a LocalDate for a parameter.

methods.name: isChangeInStringParameterNamed
methods.description: Checks if a String parameter value has changed.

methods.name: enumValueOfParameterNamed
methods.description: Converts a parameter value to an Enum.

methods.name: stringValueOfParameterNamed
methods.description: Extracts a String value for a parameter.

methods.name: stringValueOfParameterNamedAllowingNull
methods.description: Extracts a String value, allowing null.

methods.name: mapValueOfParameterNamed
methods.description: Converts a JSON string to a Map<String, String>.

methods.name: mapObjectValueOfParameterNamed
methods.description: Converts a JSON string to a Map<String, Object>.

methods.name: isChangeInBigDecimalParameterNamedDefaultingZeroToNull
methods.description: Checks if a BigDecimal parameter has changed, treating zero as null.

methods.name: isChangeInBigDecimalParameterNamed
methods.description: Checks if a BigDecimal parameter has changed.

methods.name: bigDecimalValueOfParameterNamed
methods.description: Extracts a BigDecimal for a parameter.

methods.name: bigDecimalValueOfParameterNamedDefaultToNullIfZero
methods.description: Extracts a BigDecimal, treating zero as null.

methods.name: isChangeInIntegerParameterNamedDefaultingZeroToNull
methods.description: Checks if an Integer parameter has changed, treating zero as null.

methods.name: integerValueOfParameterNamed
methods.description: Extracts an Integer for a parameter.

methods.name: isChangeInIntegerSansLocaleParameterNamed
methods.description: Checks if an Integer (without locale) has changed.

methods.name: integerValueSansLocaleOfParameterNamed
methods.description: Extracts an Integer without locale for a parameter.

methods.name: isChangeInBooleanParameterNamed
methods.description: Checks if a Boolean parameter has changed.

methods.name: booleanObjectValueOfParameterNamed
methods.description: Extracts a Boolean object for a parameter.

methods.name: booleanPrimitiveValueOfParameterNamed
methods.description: Extracts a primitive boolean for a parameter.

methods.name: isChangeInArrayParameterNamed
methods.description: Checks if an array parameter has changed.

methods.name: arrayValueOfParameterNamed
methods.description: Extracts a String array for a parameter.

methods.name: arrayOfParameterNamed
methods.description: Extracts a JsonArray for a parameter.

methods.name: isChangeInPasswordParameterNamed
methods.description: Checks if a password parameter has changed.

methods.name: isChangeInExternalIdParameterNamed
methods.description: Checks if an ExternalId parameter has changed.

methods.name: passwordValueOfParameterNamed
methods.description: Generates an encoded password value for a parameter.

methods.name: extractLocale
methods.description: Extracts Locale from JSON.

methods.name: checkForUnsupportedParameters
methods.description: Checks for unsupported parameters in JSON.
